class TestBackdoor:
    def test_simple_confounder_yields_backdoor_set(self):
        graph = nx.DiGraph([("Z", "X"), ("Z", "Y"), ("X", "Y")])

        backdoor_sets = Backdoor(graph, ["X"], ["Y"]).get_backdoor_vars()

        assert len(backdoor_sets) == 1
        adjustment_set = backdoor_sets[0]
        assert adjustment_set.get_adjustment_type() == AdjustmentSet.BACKDOOR
        assert set(adjustment_set.get_adjustment_variables()) == {"Z"}
        assert adjustment_set.get_num_paths_blocked_by_observed_nodes() == 1

    def test_no_backdoor_paths_yields_no_adjustment_sets(self):
        graph = nx.DiGraph([("X", "Y")])

        assert Backdoor(graph, ["X"], ["Y"]).get_backdoor_vars() == []

    def test_collider_paths_are_not_treated_as_backdoor_paths(self):
        # X -> C <- Y is a collider path, not a confounding path.
        graph = nx.DiGraph([("X", "Y"), ("X", "C"), ("Y", "C")])

        assert Backdoor(graph, ["X"], ["Y"]).get_backdoor_vars() == []

    def test_chain_confounder_is_blocked_by_an_intermediate_ancestor(self):
        graph = nx.DiGraph([("B", "A"), ("A", "X"), ("B", "Y"), ("X", "Y")])

        backdoor_sets = Backdoor(graph, ["X"], ["Y"]).get_backdoor_vars()

        assert len(backdoor_sets) == 1
        adjustment_variables = set(backdoor_sets[0].get_adjustment_variables())
        # Either node on the X <- A <- B -> Y path is a valid adjustment choice.
        assert adjustment_variables
        assert adjustment_variables <= {"A", "B"}

    def test_two_independent_confounders_are_both_selected(self):
        graph = nx.DiGraph(
            [("A", "X"), ("A", "Y"), ("B", "X"), ("B", "Y"), ("X", "Y")]
        )

    def test_is_backdoor_detects_incoming_edge_from_first_path_node(self):

            expression.get_val("unknown")

        expression = IDExpression()
        expression.add_product(
            {"outcome_vars": OrderedSet(["Y"]), "condition_vars": OrderedSet(["X", "Z"])}
        )

        assert str(expression) == "Predictor: P(Y|X,Z)"

    def test_str_of_single_predictor_without_conditioning(self):
        expression = IDExpression()
        expression.add_product({"outcome_vars": OrderedSet(["Y"]), "condition_vars": OrderedSet([])})

        )

class TestDeepCopy:
    def test_deepcopy_preserves_state_and_is_independent(self):
        identifier = object()
        estimand = IdentifiedEstimand(
            identifier,
            "X",
            "Y",
            estimand_type="ate",
            estimands={"backdoor": make_estimand_expr()},
            backdoor_variables={"backdoor1": ["Z"]},
            default_backdoor_id="backdoor1",
            identifier_method="backdoor1",
        )

        copied = copy.deepcopy(estimand)

        assert copied is not estimand
        assert copied.treatment_variable == estimand.treatment_variable
        assert copied.estimands == estimand.estimands
        assert copied.default_backdoor_id == "backdoor1"
        assert copied.identifier_method == "backdoor1"
        # The identifier object is intentionally not deep-copied.
        assert copied.identifier is identifier

        copied.backdoor_variables["backdoor1"].append("W")
        assert estimand.backdoor_variables["backdoor1"] == ["Z"]
